1945, October 2
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 Jerome Street ; Brooklyn 7, N. Y.
Feast of the Holy Guardian Angels October 2, 1945
My Dear Brother -- Fr. M. Joachim:
God bless you and yours. I meant to write you a letter to-day a number of times and now its 11 P.M. Well, how can we thank the Good God for all His patience with us and all the graces lavished upon each ?! Thirty-two yrs back Oct. 2 -- we Fr. E'd, Jim (R. I. P.) and I awoke in the "Bad-Lands of N. D." Jim's keen eye espied a kyote scrambling up one of the peculiar formations to which he called our attention - - - - How short it now seems! What changes since! But looking forward, what changes are ahead in half 32 years! ? Let us bless and adore the Providence that has kept us and have all in His hands who keep tally on the hairs of our heads. and the sighes and the breaths we take -- and notwithstanding our blunders and stupid- ity still plans on for our best. Only this P. M. I received, Via Detroit, Mich, my own letter to Fr. E'd, back from the Phil- ippines. He ought to know what's in it by tomorrow. I forget. Mail-marked five months tomorrow. I just reddressed it and added a 3rd Air Stamp.
I am praying the dear, Good God to guide you whither you'll find it more congenial than you resigned yourself to the past few years. Nevertheless dear Fr. M. Joachim, its good for us.
October 7, 1945
Dear Fr. M. J:
I just found this as I left it several days ago. I meant to reach you by this Sunday and here it is 9:30 P. M. --- just got back half an hour back from old people's Home in Staten Island . . . . God's blessing to yourself and Fr. Edw'd -- Rt. Rev. to all
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. C.
